[[File:Fullsizeoutput 22cf.jpeg|thumb|220x220px|Demandred encounters an Adult Jumara Worm. Concept Art by JDRAFO]]A '''jumara''', also known as a '''Worm''',{{ref/book|1|49}}{{ref/book|6|23}}{{ref/book|twotc|Jumara (Shadowspawn)|Jumara}}{{ref/book|twotc|Worm}} is a type of [[Shadowspawn]] that was created by [[Aginor]] sometime before or during the [[War of Power]], and found in the [[Blight]]. They can live for thousands of years and get stronger if the [[One Power]] is used against them. The only source depicting any direct encounter with a jumara, juvenile or mature, is the {{ros}} sequence that was cut from {{amol}}.

==General Observations==

Unlike other Shadowspawn, they don't seem to be marshalled by the forces of the Dark One against the forces of the Light. [[Demandred]] speculated that [[Aginor]] created them not as a means of achieving victory for the Shadow, but simply to create a maximally terrible creature.{{ref/book|ros}} They seem uncontrollable and the usual mechanism that allows the Chosen to command Shadowspawn does not apply to jumara, as evidenced by the fact Demandred is forced to battle one to the death. 

They do not feel much besides hunger and (sometimes) fear.{{ref/book|1|49}} In order to kill a Worm, the Worm must be cut to pieces.{{ref/book|1|49}}{{ref/book|twotc|Worm}}  They prefer human meat over Trolloc meat.{{ref/book|13|p}}

== Physical description and size==
[[File:Jumara.png|thumb|300px|right|Depiction of size of a transformed jumara relative to a human male by Chris Moorhead.]]

We have no physical description of the juvenile jumara. It's possibly that the nickname "Worms" indicates that they do not have legs and crawl or burrow, if extremely quickly.

Adult jumara are multi-pedal insectoid creatures. They are covered in spines and tentacles, particularly around their mouth, and grow to gigantic size. Direct use of the One Power against them serves only to make them stronger. They were noted by Demandred as being nearly immortal unless slain, as they could go into hibernation for millennia, waking only if prey happened to touch one of their tentacles or spines. 

==Juvenile Jumara==
Like many Shadowspawn, the natural habitat of jumara in the [[Third Age]] is the [[Blight]]. Unlike other Shadowspawn, they don't seem to be marshalled by the forces of the Dark One against the forces of the Light. 

Sammael mentions that those found in the Blight are fully-grown, but will never "transform".{{ref/book|6|23}} The conditions to trigger the transformation are not known, and therefore neither can the reason this will never occur for those living in the Blight.

Worms are extremely dangerous. A single Worm can easily kill a [[Myrrdraal]] unless the Myrdraal is extremely lucky; most of the terrifying creatures in the Blight will flee from a Worm, although the Worms themselves are scared of whatever creatures live in the high passes of the [[Blasted Lands|Blasted]] Lands.{{ref/book|1|49}} They travel in groups known as Wormpacks and cry to one another with a reedy, shrill scream. The Emond's Fielders with Lan and Moiraine hear a group of half a dozen worms "singing among themselves" as in a chorus. They are fast and effective at overtaking their prey.{{ref/book|1|49}} Fain (as Mordeth) kills a Worm and says that a pack of worms can kill a whole legion.{{ref/book|13|p}}

== Mature Jumara ==

Adult jumara are vastly more dangerous than their juvenile forms.

While searching for the remaining half of [[Sakarnen]] in Shara, [[Demandred]] encountered an adult jumara at [[Rai'lair]], The Hearttomb. Somehow the creature had found the ancient cavern as a juvenile, and had matured to adulthood inside. The resulting creature had been too large to fit back out through the mouth of the cave, and so it had made the cavern its home, eating anything that entered.{{ref/book|ros}}

It was described by Demandred as being easily 100 feet long. Demandred only just barely managed to slay the creature, and afterwards commented to himself that he nearly did not survive the encounter despite knowing exactly what it was and how to go about killing it.

== Terminology ==

In the Third Age, jumara are known as "Worms." Whether the term refers specifically to the larval form or broadly to the entire species is difficult to determine. [[Sammael]] mentions that the jumara in the Blight are referred to as "Worms" and that they will never transform into the mature form.{{ref/book|6|23}} It is therefore likely that the term "Worm" developed among people with no knowledge that a mature form even existed. [[Demandred]] never uses the term when he confronts the mature jumara,{{ref/book|ros}} but that may not be significant.

The Companion entry on Worms is ambiguous. It conflates the terms "Worms" and "jumara," specifically describes the creatures living in the Blight, and mentions that "they" (i.e. "Worms" and "jumara") can transform in some way.{{ref/book|twotc|Worm}} The entry for "jumara" uses different verbiage, but similarly conflates the terms and states that they transform.{{ref/book|twotc|Jumara (Shadowspawn)|Jumara}}

In {{ros}}, Demandred refers to the mature form he faces both as "jumara" and (after killing it) as "jumara'nai." "Jumara'nai" could refer to the mature form and "jumara" either to the entire species or specifically the juvenile form (Demandred's use of "jumara" here being a technically incorrect but perfectly comprehensible use).{{ref/book|ros}}
